name: Jira Service Management Operations
desc: Opsgenie alerts in Jira Service Management: create, acknowledge, close and route on-call alerts, and see who is on call.

actions.name: create_alert
actions.description: Create a new alert and route it to teams, users or schedules.

actions.name: get_alert
actions.description: Get one alert by its ID or alias.

actions.name: find_alerts
actions.description: Search alerts with a JSM Operations search query.

actions.name: acknowledge_alert
actions.description: Acknowledge an alert so responders know someone is on it.

actions.name: unacknowledge_alert
actions.description: Put an acknowledged alert back to open.

actions.name: close_alert
actions.description: Close an alert once the problem is resolved.

actions.name: add_note
actions.description: Add a note to an alert.

actions.name: add_tags
actions.description: Add one or more tags to an alert.

actions.name: remove_tags
actions.description: Remove one or more tags from an alert.

actions.name: assign_alert
actions.description: Make a user the owner of an alert. Not available on the JSM Free plan.

actions.name: add_responder
actions.description: Add a team, user, schedule or escalation as a responder.

actions.name: escalate_alert
actions.description: Escalate an alert to the next level of an escalation policy.

actions.name: snooze_alert
actions.description: Pause notifications for an alert until a set time. Not on JSM Free.

actions.name: update_alert
actions.description: Change the message, description or priority of an alert.

actions.name: get_on_call
actions.description: Get who is on call for a schedule, now or at a given time.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Call any JSM Operations endpoint with this connection.

triggers.name: new_alert
triggers.description: Triggers when a new alert is created.
